{{Infobox auto}}
The '''porkchop''' is a food item with the classic porkchop texture. It heals {{Value|Porkchop|heals}} the moment it is used, but the pack gives it no recipe, trade or drop: it can only be obtained with the <code>/loot</code> command. It is a different item from the [[Raw Porkchop|raw porkchop]] that pigs drop.

== Obtaining ==
The datapack has a loot table for it, <code>matcha:treasure/porkchop_classic</code>, which no chest, mob or trade uses, so it can only be given with <code>/loot give @s loot matcha:treasure/porkchop_classic</code>.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/treasure/porkchop_classic.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
=== Food ===
The item is a vanilla porkchop with a changed model (<code>matcha:porkchop_classic</code>) and the name "Porkchop". It is consumed at once, with no eating animation or sound, and applies Instant Health when used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/treasure/porkchop_classic.json}}</ref>
